description_en: Queries the information about a specified IPsec-VPN connection
description_zh: 调用DescribeVpnConnection接口查询指定的IPsec连接的信息
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-vpn-connection --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpn-connection-id vco-bp1bbi27hojx80nck0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVpnConnection

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the IPsec-VPN connection.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
IPsec连接所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the IPsec-VPN connection
parameters.name: vpn_connection_id

AttachInstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance to which the transit router instance belongs
AttachInstanceId.description_zh: 转发路由器实例所属的云企业网实例ID

AttachType.description_en:
The type of resource attached to the IPsec-VPN connection.

CEN: The IPsec-VPN connection is attached to a transit router of a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance.
NO_ASSOCIATED: The IPsec-VPN connection is not attached to any resource.
VPNGW: The IPsec-VPN connection is attached to a VPN gateway instance
AttachType.description_zh:
IPsec连接绑定的资源类型。

CEN：表示IPsec连接已绑定云企业网实例下的转发路由器实例。
NO_ASSOCIATED：表示IPsec连接未绑定任何资源。
VPNGW：表示IPsec连接绑定了VPN网关实例

CreateTime.description_en:
The timestamp when the IPsec-VPN connection was created. Unit: milliseconds.

The timestamp is in the UNIX timestamp format, which represents the total number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 (UTC) to the time when the IPsec-VPN connection was created
CreateTime.description_zh:
创建IPsec连接的时间戳。单位：毫秒。

时间戳的格式采用Unix时间戳，表示从格林威治时间1970年01月01日00时00分00秒至创建IPsec连接时的总时长

CrossAccountAuthorized.description_en: Indicates whether the IPsec-VPN connection is bound to a transit router instance under a different account
CrossAccountAuthorized.description_zh:
IPsec连接是否绑定了跨账号的转发路由器实例。

true：是。
false：否

CustomerGatewayId.description_en: The ID of the customer gateway associated with the IPsec-VPN connection

EffectImmediately.description_en:
Indicates whether the IPsec-VPN connection configurations take effect immediately.

true: The configurations take effect immediately. A reconnection is triggered after the configuration change is complete.

false: The configurations do not take effect immediately. A reconnection is triggered when traffic is detected
EffectImmediately.description_zh:
IPsec连接的配置是否立即生效。

true：是，配置变更完成后触发重连。

false：否，有流量时触发重连

EnableDpd.description_en: Indicates whether Dead Peer Detection (DPD) is enabled for the IPsec-VPN connection
EnableDpd.description_zh:
IPsec连接是否已开启DPD（对等体存活检测）功能。
false：未开启。

true：已开启。

开启DPD功能后，IPsec发起端会发送DPD报文用来检测对端的设备是否存活，如果在设定时间内未收到正确回应则认为对端已经断线，IPsec将删除ISAKMP SA和相应的IPsec SA，安全隧道同样也会被删除

EnableNatTraversal.description_en: Indicates whether NAT traversal is enabled for the IPsec-VPN connection
EnableNatTraversal.description_zh:
IPsec连接是否已开启NAT穿越功能。

true：开启NAT穿越功能。

false：不开启NAT穿越功能。

开启NAT穿越功能后，IKE协商过程会删除对UDP端口号的验证过程，同时实现对VPN隧道中NAT网关设备的发现功能

EnableTunnelsBgp.description_en: The enabling status of tunnel BGP
EnableTunnelsBgp.description_zh:
隧道BGP的开启状态。

true：已开启。
false：未开启

IkeAuthAlg.description_en: The authentication algorithm in the IKE phase

IkeEncAlg.description_en: The encryption algorithm in the IKE phase

IkeLifetime.description_en: The IKE phase lifetime. Unit: seconds

IkeMode.description_zh:
IKE协商模式。

main：主模式，协商过程安全性高。
aggressive：野蛮模式，协商快速且协商成功率高

IkePfs.description_en: The DH group in the IKE phase

IkeVersion.description_en:
The IKE protocol version.

ikev1
ikev2

Compared with IKEv1, IKEv2 simplifies the SA negotiation process and provides better support for multi-CIDR-block scenarios
IkeVersion.description_zh:
IKE协议版本。

ikev1
ikev2

相对于IKEv1版本，IKEv2版本简化了SA的协商过程并且对于多网段的场景提供了更好的支持

LocalId.description_en: The identifier on the Alibaba Cloud side of the IPsec-VPN connection

RemoteId.description_en: The identifier on the on-premises data center side of the IPsec-VPN connection
RemoteId.description_zh: IPsec连接本地数据中心侧的标识

InternetIp.description_en: The gateway IP address of the IPsec-VPN connection

IpsecAuthAlg.description_en: The authentication algorithm in the IPsec phase

IpsecEncAlg.description_en: The encryption algorithm in the IPsec phase

IpsecLifetime.description_en: The IPsec phase lifetime. Unit: seconds

IpsecPfs.description_en: The DH group in the IPsec phase

LocalSubnet.description_en: The CIDR block on the Alibaba Cloud side of the IPsec-VPN connection
LocalSubnet.description_zh:
IPsec连接阿里云侧的网段。

在多个网段的情况下，网段之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔

Name.description_en: The name of the IPsec-VPN connection

NetworkType.description_en:
The network type of the IPsec-VPN connection.

public: public network. The IPsec-VPN connection establishes an encrypted communication channel over the Internet.
private: private network. The IPsec-VPN connection establishes an encrypted communication channel over a private network
NetworkType.description_zh:
IPsec连接的网络类型。

public：公网，表示IPsec连接通过公网建立加密通信通道。
private：私网，表示IPsec连接通过私网建立加密通信通道

RemoteCaCertificate.description_en: The CA certificate of the peer

RemoteSubnet.description_en: The CIDR block on the on-premises data center side
RemoteSubnet.description_zh:
本地数据中心侧的网段。

在多个网段的情况下，网段之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔

ResourceGroupId.description_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the IPsec-VPN connection belongs.

You can call the [ListResourceGroups]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html） operation to query resource group information
ResourceGroupId.description_zh:
IPsec连接所属资源组ID。

您可以调用[ListResourceGroups]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html）接口查询资源组信息

Spec.description_en: The bandwidth specification of the IPsec-VPN connection. Unit: Mbps

State.description_en: The binding status between the IPsec-VPN connection and the transit router instance
State.description_zh:
IPsec连接与转发路由器实例的绑定状态。

active：IPsec连接已与VPN网关实例绑定，状态正常。
init：IPsec连接未绑定任何资源，IPsec连接初始化。
attaching：IPsec连接与转发路由器实例绑定中。
attached：IPsec连接已与转发路由器实例绑定。
detaching：IPsec连接与转发路由器实例解绑中。
financialLocked：欠费锁定。
provisioning：资源准备中。
updating：更新中。
upgrading：升级中。
deleted：已删除

Status.description_en:
The status of the IPsec-VPN connection.

ike_sa_not_established: Phase 1 negotiation failed.

ike_sa_established: Phase 1 negotiation succeeded.

ipsec_sa_not_established: Phase 2 negotiation failed.

ipsec_sa_established: Phase 2 negotiation succeeded
Status.description_zh:
IPsec连接的状态。

ike_sa_not_established：第一阶段协商失败。

ike_sa_established：第一阶段协商成功。

ipsec_sa_not_established：第二阶段协商失败。

ipsec_sa_established：第二阶段协商成功

Tag.description_en: The list of tags bound to the IPsec-VPN connection

TransitRouterId.description_en: The instance ID of the transit router instance attached to the IPsec-VPN connection
TransitRouterId.description_zh: IPsec连接绑定的转发路由器实例ID

TransitRouterName.description_en: The name of the transit router instance
TransitRouterName.description_zh: 转发路由器实例的名称

TunnelBandwidth.description_en: The bandwidth specification of a single VPN tunnel. Valid values:
TunnelBandwidth.description_zh:
用于说明VPN单条隧道的带宽规格，取值：
Standard（默认值）：标准型，默认带宽1Gbps
Large（大型）：大型，默认带宽3Gbps
TunnelBandwidth.title_zh:
用于说明VPN单条隧道的带宽规格，取值：
Standard（默认值）：标准型，默认带宽1Gbps
Large（大型）：大型，默认带宽3Gbps

TunnelOptions.description_en: The tunnel configuration of the IPsec-VPN connection
TunnelOptions.description_zh:
IPsec连接的隧道配置信息。

仅查询双隧道模式的IPsec连接会返回TunnelOptionsSpecification数组下的参数

CustomerGatewayId.description_en: The ID of the customer gateway associated with the tunnel

EnableDpd.description_en: Indicates whether Dead Peer Detection (DPD) is enabled for the tunnel
EnableDpd.description_zh:
隧道是否已开启DPD（对等体存活检测）功能。
false：未开启。
true：已开启

EnableNatTraversal.description_en: Indicates whether NAT traversal is enabled for the tunnel
EnableNatTraversal.description_zh:
隧道是否已开启NAT穿越功能。

false：未开启。
true：已开启

InternetIp.description_en: The IP address of the tunnel

RemoteCaCertificate.description_en: The CA certificate of the tunnel peer
RemoteCaCertificate.description_zh:
隧道对端的CA证书。

仅VPN网关实例的类型为国密型时才会返回当前参数

Role.description_zh:
隧道的角色。

master：表示当前隧道为主隧道。
slave：表示当前隧道为备隧道

State.description_zh:
隧道的状态。

active：状态正常。
updating：更新中。
deleting：删除中

Status.description_en: The status of the IPsec-VPN connection
Status.description_zh:
IPsec连接的状态。

ike_sa_not_established：第一阶段协商失败。

ike_sa_established：第一阶段协商成功。

ipsec_sa_not_established：第二阶段协商失败。

ipsec_sa_established：第二阶段协商成功

TunnelBgpConfig.description_en: The BGP configuration of the tunnel

BgpStatus.description_zh:
BGP的协商状态。

success：正常。
failed：异常

LocalAsn.description_en: The autonomous system number on the local end (Alibaba Cloud side) of the tunnel
LocalAsn.description_zh: 隧道本端（阿里云侧）的自治系统号

LocalBgpIp.description_en: The BGP IP address on the local end (Alibaba Cloud side) of the tunnel
LocalBgpIp.description_zh: 隧道本端（阿里云侧）的BGP地址

PeerAsn.description_en: The autonomous system number of the tunnel peer
PeerAsn.description_zh: 隧道对端的自治系统号

PeerBgpIp.description_en: The BGP IP address of the tunnel peer

TunnelCidr.description_en: The BGP CIDR block of the tunnel

IkeEncAlg.description_en: The encryption algorithm in the IKE phase

IkeLifetime.description_en: The IKE phase lifetime. Unit: seconds

IkeMode.description_zh:
IKE协商模式。

main：主模式，协商过程安全性高。
aggressive：野蛮模式，协商快速且协商成功率高

IkePfs.description_en: The DH group in the IKE phase

LocalId.description_zh: 隧道本端（阿里云侧）的标识

TunnelIndex.description_zh:
隧道的创建顺序。

VcoHealthCheck.description_en: The health check information of the IPsec-VPN connection

Enable.description_en:
Indicates whether health check is enabled for the IPsec-VPN connection.

false: Not enabled.

true: Enabled

IPsec连接是否已开启健康检查。

Interval.description_en: The retry interval of the health check. Unit: seconds
Interval.description_zh: 健康检查的重试间隔时间，单位：秒

Policy.description_en: Indicates whether published routes are withdrawn when the health check fails
Policy.description_zh:
健康检查失败时是否撤销已发布的路由。

revoke_route：撤销路由。
reserve_route：不撤销路由

Retry.description_en: The number of health check retries
Retry.description_zh: 健康检查的重试发包次数

Status.description_zh:
健康检查状态。

failed：异常。

success：正常

VpnBgpConfig.description_en: The BGP routing protocol configuration of the IPsec-VPN connection
VpnBgpConfig.description_zh: IPsec连接BGP路由协议的配置信息

AuthKey.description_en: The authentication key of the BGP routing protocol

EnableBgp.description_zh:

true：已开启。

success：正常。

failed：异常

TunnelCidr.description_zh: IPsec连接BGP网段。该网段是一个在169.254.0.0/16内的子网掩码长度为30的网段
